# pai power

Battery: status, keep-above wait for the next local job, charge-rate calibration

```
pai power <command>
```

The battery guard's toolkit (config power.batteryGuard). `status` shows the reading, thresholds, the stored calibration, the estimated minutes until the keep-above gate opens, and whether macOS Low Power Mode is on (power.lowPower.factor stretches worker time limits while it is). `wait` blocks until the battery allows the next local job: at or above keepAbovePct it returns at once, below it it pauses in 10-minute steps (one line each) until resumeAtPct, then exits 0. `calibrate` measures the idle charge rate (%/h) over N minutes and stores it in power.calibration; it refuses while a worker runs on a local provider. New local workers honour keepAbovePct by queueing; running ones are never stopped by it.

```sh
pai power status
pai power wait --above 40 --resume 45
pai power calibrate --minutes 10
pai power calibrate --load --minutes 10
```

See also: `pai config set power.batteryGuard.keepAbovePct 40`

### pai power status

Battery %, charging state, thresholds, calibration, minutes until resume, Low Power Mode

```
pai power status
```

Reads the battery once and prints the guard thresholds, the keep-above gate state, the stored calibration and whether Low Power Mode is on.

```sh
pai power status
```

### pai power wait

Block until the battery allows the next local job

```
pai power wait [options]
```

Exits 0 at once when the battery is at or above the keep-above level (--above, else power.batteryGuard.keepAbovePct). Below it, pauses in 10-minute steps, one line per pause, until the resume level (--resume, else resumeAtPct, else keep + 5). Exits 0 at once when no level is set or the battery is unreadable.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--above PCT` | number | — | Keep-above level (default: power.batteryGuard.keepAbovePct) |
| `--resume PCT` | number | — | Resume level (default: power.batteryGuard.resumeAtPct) |
| `--step MIN` | number | 10 | Minutes per pause |

```sh
pai power wait
pai power wait --above 40 --resume 45
```

### pai power calibrate

Measure the charge rate (%/h) and store it in power.calibration

```
pai power calibrate [options]
```

Idle (default): reads the battery, waits N minutes, reads again, prints and stores the rate; refuses while a worker runs on a local provider or a benchmark is live. --load measures the drain over the next N minutes of whatever is running instead and stores it as the load rate. The battery reports whole percents, so short windows are coarse.

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--minutes N` | number | 10 | Measuring window in minutes |
| `--load` | flag | — | Measure under whatever load runs now (no idle check) |

```sh
pai power calibrate
pai power calibrate --minutes 20
pai power calibrate --load --minutes 10
```
